summary: This study aims to develop a retina-specific treatment for familial dysautonomia (FD), a neurodegenerative disorder causing progressive blindness, by evaluating systemic and local therapeutic approaches to rescue visual function in FD. Researchers will investigate the efficacy of these treatments in novel retina-specific conditional Elp1 knock-out mice with human ELP1 transgene containing FD mutation through comprehensive visual function testing using electrophysiological and optokinetic methods. Additionally, they will use single-cell RNA sequencing to identify key regulatory pathways involved in retinal ganglion cell (RGC) survival and investigate RGC degeneration in patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cell RGCs.
